mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_role AS role, u.center_id AS centerId, u.user_email AS email, u.manager_phone_access AS visible FROM users u WHERE u.user_email = #{email} LIMIT 1

SELECT partition_id AS partitionId, partition_type AS partitionType, segment AS segment, name AS name, color AS color FROM sales_partitions WHERE partition_type = #{partitionType} ORDER BY segment ASC

WITH user_base AS ( SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.user_approved AS userApproved, ce.center_id AS centerId, ce.center_name AS centerName, br.branch_id AS branchId, br.branch_name AS branchName FROM users u LEFT JOIN centers ce ON ce.center_id = u.center_id LEFT JOIN branches br ON br.branch_id = ce.branch_id WHERE u.center_id IS NOT NULL AND u.center_id <> 1 AND u.user_role IN ('MANAGER','STAFF')
AND u.user_approved <> 'X'
),
base AS ( SELECT ub.userId, ub.userName, ub.userApproved, ub.centerId, ub.centerName, ub.branchId, ub.branchName, c.customer_id AS customerId FROM user_base ub LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.user_id = ub.userId ),
-- ✅ endTs 기준 마지막 RESET (reset anchor) reset_anchor AS ( SELECT customer_id, MAX(log_id) AS reset_log_id FROM sales_logs WHERE sales_type = 'RESET' AND action_at < #{endTs} GROUP BY customer_id ),
-- endTs 직전 최신 INITIAL/UPSELL (reset anchor 이후) initial_end_id AS ( SELECT sl.customer_id, MAX(sl.log_id) AS log_id FROM sales_logs sl LEFT JOIN reset_anchor r ON r.customer_id = sl.customer_id WHERE sl.sales_type = 'INITIAL' AND sl.action_at < #{endTs} AND sl.log_id > IFNULL(r.reset_log_id, 0) GROUP BY sl.customer_id ), initial_end AS ( SELECT i.customer_id, l.amount FROM initial_end_id i JOIN sales_logs l ON l.log_id = i.log_id ), upsell_end_id AS ( SELECT sl.customer_id, MAX(sl.log_id) AS log_id FROM sales_logs sl LEFT JOIN reset_anchor r ON r.customer_id = sl.customer_id WHERE sl.sales_type = 'UPSELL' AND sl.action_at < #{endTs} AND sl.log_id > IFNULL(r.reset_log_id, 0) GROUP BY sl.customer_id ), upsell_end AS ( SELECT u.customer_id, l.amount FROM upsell_end_id u JOIN sales_logs l ON l.log_id = u.log_id ),
-- startTs 직전 최신 INITIAL/UPSELL (같은 reset anchor 이후) initial_start_id AS ( SELECT sl.customer_id, MAX(sl.log_id) AS log_id FROM sales_logs sl LEFT JOIN reset_anchor r ON r.customer_id = sl.customer_id WHERE sl.sales_type = 'INITIAL' AND sl.action_at < #{startTs} AND sl.log_id > IFNULL(r.reset_log_id, 0) GROUP BY sl.customer_id ), initial_start AS ( SELECT i.customer_id, l.amount FROM initial_start_id i JOIN sales_logs l ON l.log_id = i.log_id ), upsell_start_id AS ( SELECT sl.customer_id, MAX(sl.log_id) AS log_id FROM sales_logs sl LEFT JOIN reset_anchor r ON r.customer_id = sl.customer_id WHERE sl.sales_type = 'UPSELL' AND sl.action_at < #{startTs} AND sl.log_id > IFNULL(r.reset_log_id, 0) GROUP BY sl.customer_id ), upsell_start AS ( SELECT u.customer_id, l.amount FROM upsell_start_id u JOIN sales_logs l ON l.log_id = u.log_id )
SELECT
CONCAT('b', IFNULL(b.branchId, 0)) AS `key`,
CONCAT('t', IFNULL(b.centerId, 0)) AS `key`,
CONCAT('p', b.userId) AS `key`,
IFNULL(b.branchName, '') AS label,
IFNULL(b.centerName, '') AS label,
IFNULL(b.userName, '') AS label,
-- a,b,c (c는 일단 0) SUM(GREATEST(0, IFNULL(ie.amount, 0) - IFNULL(is1.amount, 0))) AS a, SUM(GREATEST(0, IFNULL(ue.amount, 0) - IFNULL(us1.amount, 0))) AS b, 0 AS c,
-- resigned: PERSON만 의미있게(팀/지점은 false로 고정)
CASE WHEN MAX(b.userApproved = 'X') = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS resigned
0 AS resigned
FROM base b LEFT JOIN initial_end ie ON ie.customer_id = b.customerId LEFT JOIN initial_start is1 ON is1.customer_id = b.customerId LEFT JOIN upsell_end ue ON ue.customer_id = b.customerId LEFT JOIN upsell_start us1 ON us1.customer_id = b.customerId
GROUP BY CONCAT('b', IFNULL(b.branchId, 0)), IFNULL(b.branchName, '')
GROUP BY CONCAT('t', IFNULL(b.centerId, 0)), IFNULL(b.centerName, '')
GROUP BY CONCAT('p', b.userId), IFNULL(b.userName, '')
ORDER BY (SUM(GREATEST(0, IFNULL(ie.amount, 0) - IFNULL(is1.amount, 0))) + SUM(GREATEST(0, IFNULL(ue.amount, 0) - IFNULL(us1.amount, 0)))) DESC
